title: Go: Slices
description: Write a Go program that demonstrates slice creation, reslicing, and append operations.

codeTemplate.go:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	numbers := []int{1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
	fmt.Println("Original:", numbers)

	subset := numbers[1:4]
	fmt.Println("Subset [1:4]:", subset)

	numbers = append(numbers, 6, 7)
	fmt.Println("After append:", numbers)

	fmt.Println("Length:", len(numbers))
	fmt.Println("Capacity:", cap(numbers))
}

hints: Use `slice[start:end]` to create a sub-slice (end is exclusive)
`len()` returns length, `cap()` returns capacity of the underlying array
